hero.name: Quinn Doak
hero.title: Cybersecurity @ Old Dominion University · Political Science minor

paragraphs: Hi! I'm Quinn, a B.S. Cybersecurity student at Old Dominion University (Class of 2027) with a minor in political science, based in Chesapeake, Virginia. Most of my time goes into networking, Linux, and hands-on lab work, and this past summer I taught cybersecurity to high schoolers at ODU's CyberAI Summer Camp. The political science minor keeps me plugged into the policy and governance side of security too, which is where a lot of it actually gets decided. Outside of school I'm into live music, working on my car, and anything that gets me outside.
U.S. Citizen · Eligible for Secret clearance
